ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels to high-intensity white/light-gray pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pigmentation regions are concentrated on the distal outer thirds of both lobes; the central area surrounding the median notch is solid low-intensity black; significant black punctate mottling is visible within the white distal fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; approximate pixel angle of 45-50 degrees relative to the horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by sharp peaks (5-15 pixel amplitude) and wide valleys along the entire visible trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve transitioning from the extreme distal tips toward the median notch, interrupted by localized serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Prominent, high-relief clusters of light-colored circular structures (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; dark circular spots are mapped within the white distal pigmentation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, faint, light-gray linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left black quadrant of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological encrustation (likely Coronula barnacles) at both distal tips; irregular trailing edge geometry suggesting historical wear or minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced specular highlights (glare) along the upper edge of the pigmentation boundary caused by water-film reflection.
